kurzbeschreibung: The Ris-Schlössl in Flaurling near Telfs is a significant 15th-century historic manor featuring art-historically valuable frescoes.
beschreibung:
Late Gothic Manor in the Tyrolean Inntal

Near Telfs, in the municipality of Flaurling, stands the historic Ris-Schlössl. Originally built in the 15th century as a hunting lodge for Duke Sigmund der Münzreiche, the estate later developed into an elegant country residence for the caretaker Sigmund Ris.

Cultural-Historical Gem in the Oberland

The estate captivates with its characteristic Late Gothic architecture featuring prominent oriels and an ornately decorated courtyard. Art historians particularly prize the rare early Renaissance frescoes in the library room, which testify to the humanist spirit of the 16th century.
